name: German VAT ID (Umsatzsteuer-Identifikationsnummer)
description:
Detects German VAT identification numbers. Format: DE prefix followed by 9 digits. Validates using ISO 7064 Mod 11,10 iterative algorithm (community heuristic — BZSt does not publish a normative check-digit specification).

Format: DE123456789 — DE prefix + 9 digits
Official name: Umsatzsteuer-Identifikationsnummer (USt-IdNr.)
Note: Checksum is a community heuristic; structural match is authoritative

effect.message: German VAT ID tokenized for de-identification
